description.value: North Coast Trail Backpackers Hostel is a budget hostel in Port Hardy, BC, serving as a natural base for hikers and cyclists tackling the remote North Coast Trail on the northern tip of Vancouver Island. Port Hardy is a common start or end point for the Inside Passage ferry route, making this hostel a strategic stop for cycle tourists traveling between the BC mainland and Vancouver Island. The hostel is within the small Port Hardy town core.
